**Finding: compliant** — no redline proposed.

The licence package in § 13 (read with § 14.3 and § 24) already sits at our preferred position:

- **§ 13.1** — worldwide, non-exclusive subscription right granted to "Customer, its Affiliates, and contractors acting on their behalf," with Authorized Users permitted. Affiliates and contractors are in the grant itself, with no written-notice gating (better than the fallback).
- **§ 13.2** — perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free, fully paid licence to Customer and its Affiliates for paid-up/embedded Vendor Technology, including modification and derivative works, and contractor support. § 14.3 confirms this licence reaches Vendor Technology required to use a Deliverable.
- **§ 13.3** — transfer to an Affiliate or successor permitted in connection with a § 24 assignment (and § 24.1 lets us assign to an M&A successor without consent); revocation or suspension is confined to a material uncured payment or use breach after notice and a reasonable cure opportunity.
- **§ 13.4** restrictions carve out lawful reverse engineering and security-exhibit testing, and § 24.4 bars suspension or repricing on our change of control.

Document-wide searches for "revoc" and "suspend" surfaced no at-will revocation or suspension right, so the walk-away risk is absent.
